summary: ICICI Bank Ltd filed a Form 6-K to announce scheduled conference calls: a media call and an earnings call for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 18, 2026. The filing provides dial-in details and pre-registration links but discloses no deal terms, no change of control, no capital event, no activist activity, no strategic review, and no board or management change. This is purely a routine communication regarding financial results presentation. No special-situation categorization applies.
